verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe a Secure Cloud tier whose machines are verified to sit in datacenters with a Tier 2/3 rating or ISO 27001, which covers the datacenter-tier part of the story. The pack has no evidence of SOC 2 attestation, data-handling or retention policies, or a trust/compliance portal for checking posture before onboarding. A community report of a host misrepresenting its location raises concern about listing accuracy, but it is not tied to Secure Cloud certification, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: SOC 2 report or attestation, documented data-handling/privacy policy, trust center or compliance documentation access, independent corroboration of datacenter verification.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it

citations.quote: Vast verifies that these machines are in a datacenter with a TIER 2/3 rating or ISO 27001. These offer cards have a blue label and are recommended for production
Secure Cloud (Datacenter): These machines are verified and confirmed to be in a certified datacenter that meets our datacenter criteria.
